prompt: Do a ruthless efficiency audit of the Django app at /home/bguest/personal-skills/skills/_fixtures/vuln-app. Find the worst performance/cost problems and quantify each. Do not change your working directory.

assertions.text: Reports between 1 and 3 confirmed findings (respects the stop-early cap)
Surfaces at least one N+1 query pattern (get_order_totals E1 or enrich_orders E2)
Every finding includes a concrete cost analysis (complexity class or query count as a function of N), not just 'this is slow'
Every finding cites a file:line location
All reported findings are efficiency/performance issues, not security vulnerabilities
Each finding proposes a concrete, stack-idiomatic fix
